headline: Seasonal dip exacerbated by geopolitical headwinds; deleveraging on track and guidance intact

highlights: Organic growth was 14% YoY in Q2 and 15.7% in H1, above the 12–15% guided range.
FY27 guidance was reaffirmed – revenue at the upper end of INR 30–31bn and adj.
Conference call takeaways • Management retained its FY27 guidance of revenue at the upper end of INR 30–31bn and adj.

This may be led by a sequential DMO rebound through Q3–Q4, as new budget cycles deploy, and the corporate business moving from decline in H1 to flat in H2. • In MarTech, the QoQ dip reflected the FIFA base and DMO budget timing; DMO revenue still grew more than 20% YoY.
valuation: Maintain BUY with a TP to INR 1,150 (earlier INR 1,350), as we cut our target multiple to 30x (from 35x) FY28E EPS, given limited visibility on normalcy in Middle East and recovery in the corporate business.
APMEA new sales ran at over 3x the year-ago pace and 50+ properties signed on Direct Stack in the quarter; a new Global Key Accounts team targets the top-10 accounts.

Management is comfortable with the figure at above 20% and will likely reinvest margin upside above that. • Total debt repayment is now USD 53.75mn, bringing the total repayment to ~43% of the acquisition-related loan, and remains on track to be net debt-free by FY28E.
watch: APMEA new sales ran at over 3x the year-ago pace and 50+ properties signed on Direct Stack in the quarter; a new Global Key Accounts team targets the top-10 accounts.

Smart Distribution is live with bookings flowing and 800+ directly contracted properties; management expects a ‘hockey stick’ ramp, and Direct Stack (booking engine plus payments) is seeing strong interest in APMEA.
